purpose: User-requested fresh per-game real-time audit of the other 50 historically skipped environments in the selected 100; excludes completed Forced-Perspective Moving Day review.
source_verification: Every archived file verified against its Git blob at aa085c8caa6575cde1353272b94118b7903a62a3
source_snapshot_method: Git archive, not a worktree: AGENTS.md, pyproject.toml, __init__.py, environments, shared scripts, shared runtime app/server/verifier helpers, incubator solvers, realtime.py, observation settings, and binding controllability/design docs. Historical audits, dashboard annotations, Git history and prior conversations are excluded.
selection_rule: Every distinct environment with skipped_historical status in selected_100_combined, excluding forced_perspective_moving_day_env; each must have exactly ten historical configurations.
review_wrapper_template: Perform one game-level real-time audit using {prompt_path}. Read that prompt fully. SOURCE_ROOT={source_root}; CASE_INDEX={case_index}; environment_id={environment_id}; public_environment_name={public_name}; CONFIGURATIONS={review_configurations_json}; OUTPUT_PATH={output_path}. Read this game's complete relevant implementation once and examine all five levels and both interaction modes together. Return one game JSON containing separate configuration_reports for exactly the supplied configurations. Already completed configurations are omitted deliberately; do not read or repeat their reports. Use apply_patch only for your assigned JSON. No source edits, browser/desktop access, external services, prior reviews, or nested agents. The user explicitly authorized grouped audit reports in this directory. Concurrent audit files are expected; do not stop because of them. Do not inspect the parent or grouped manifest. This is source classification, not an empirical computer-use evaluation.
